title: dect_nr: Refactor CVG PDU IE handling
description:
Refactor CVG PDU IE type handling to use register_dissector_table().
This will align with existing IE handling and make it possible to
extend unknown IEs using Lua plugins.

Implement CVG Security IE, TX Services Config IE, ARQ Feedback IE,
ARQ Poll IE and Flow Status IE.

Add the missing CVG Header F2C coding and do more code cleanup.

AI-Assisted: no
